findings.title: Fallback lookup hits DB on every translation and can crash
findings.body: FallbackLocaleList#[] in config/initializers/i18n.rb calls SiteSetting.default_locale.to_sym on every lookup. I18n::Backend::Fallbacks calls I18n.fallbacks[locale] for every missing translation, so this adds a SiteSetting read to the translation fast path and raises NoMethodError if default_locale is nil/blank or if the DB is unavailable during boot, migrations, asset precompile, or setup. Consequence is crashed requests or missing translations instead of falling back to :en.

findings.title: Fallback locales are not loaded in translate path
findings.body: I18n.translate in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb only calls load_locale(config.locale). It never loads the other locales in the fallback chain (SiteSetting.default_locale, :en) and ignores an explicit locale: option which bypasses cache but still loads config.locale. Only ApplicationController#set_locale calls I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!. Background jobs, mailers, console, and any explicit-locale lookup will therefore miss fallback translations and return missing-translation errors even though fallbacks are enabled.

findings.title: Translation LRU cache ignores fallback chain
findings.body: The cache key in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb is "#{key}#{config.locale}#{config.backend.object_id}". The resolved string now depends on SiteSetting.default_locale and the fallback files, which are not part of the key. Changing the site default locale (or updating a fallback file without reload) serves the previously cached fallback string for the same locale, i.e. stale wrong-language output.

findings.title: Loaded-locales check races and can be nil
findings.body: I18n.ensure_loaded! and I18n.translate in lib/freedom_patches/translate_accelerator.rb read @loaded_locales.include? outside LOAD_MUTEX, while load_locale mutates it inside the mutex. @loaded_locales is only initialized in reload!/ensure_loaded!, so a first translate before either raises NoMethodError on nil.include?. Concurrent requests can also double-load locale files or see a partially updated list.
